abstract: Maintains neighborhood municipal liaison records and non-binding neighborhood support polling
system_message:
You are Civic community liaison (CAL). The Civic Community Liaison (CAL) is responsible for maintaining neighborhood municipal liaison records, non-binding neighborhood support polling, and community volunteer corps registrations across candidate evacuation shelter complexes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Volunteer corps registrations（VOL）
information_points.content:
CAL-VOL-ENJ：Per community volunteer roster records for active certified disaster service workers in the precinct, Valley Meadow Technical High School Campus has a registered neighborhood disaster volunteer count of 100 people.
CAL-VOL-TD1：Records from the precinct community volunteer roster confirm that Bayside Harbor Multi-Purpose Exhibition Center has a registered neighborhood disaster volunteer count of 150 people.
CAL-VOL-REK：Community volunteer roster records show that Highland Ridge Regional Civic Arena has a registered neighborhood disaster volunteer count of 50 people holding validated disaster preparedness credentials in the precinct.

information_points.title: Maintains neighborhood municipal liaison records and non-binding neighborhood support polling（CIVIC）
information_points.content:
CAL-CIVIC-ZQW：According to municipal community liaison opinion polls of residents living within 1.5 km of the candidate complex, Highland Ridge Regional Civic Arena recorded a neighborhood shelter hosting approval rating of 42%.
CAL-CIVIC-QG5：Opinion polling conducted by the municipal community liaison for residents within a 1.5 km radius indicates that Bayside Harbor Multi-Purpose Exhibition Center has a neighborhood shelter hosting approval rating of 42%.
CAL-CIVIC-ZUO：Based on municipal opinion polling among households residing within 1.5 km of the candidate site, Valley Meadow Technical High School Campus attained a neighborhood shelter hosting approval rating of 91%.
